name.value: Kokanee Chalets RV Park and Campground

description.value: A forested cedar-grove resort on highway 3A in Crawford Bay with 17 tent sites, hot showers, an outdoor hot tub, and an onsite bakery; the beach is a 10-minute walk from camp, not at the site, and summer weekends fill fast.

address.value: 15981 Highway 3A Crawford Bay BC V0B 1E0 Canada
